notes.title: Update Note for V 2.2
notes.content:
Bug Fix


 Fix to the Jigsaw game setup


Enhancements


 Start playing the Final game as soon as you release the balls. Removes the initial wait for the balls to get into place.

 It dampens the camera spin when you click a ground tile

 Increases the sound effect of the balls dropping in the boiler game

 Moved a chair

notes.title: Major Release: Interface changes and other aspects
notes.content:
1. Interface Changes.


 Looking around is now performed by clicking the left mouse button and dragging the mouse. It is no longer necessary to move the mouse pointer to the edge of the screen and the old system is now removed.

 A waypoint navigation system has been introduced. The user will be taken around objects rather than zooming through them.

 Floor navigation has become more obvious as floor tiles are highlighted.

 The keyboard arrow keys have been retained, as an alternate way to navigate around.
 
 The move forward feature by clicking on walls has been removed - this was too confusing alongside other navigation methods.

 Help Screens are now in a more readable font
 


Visuals


 Most wall seam issues have been tidied up. The remaining seams are more subtle.

 Floor navigation is easier to see as tiles are highlighted.

 An "outside word" is now visible through the windows.



Content



 The Clown/Memory game has been better integrated into the surroundings

 Some additional environment QR hints have been introduced
